A.answer: Incident INC_037 occurred on platform version PLV_IDENTITY_2 (2024.2.0) [1]. Other markets that had incidents on a platform version with the same base version number (2024.2.0) include Greece, which experienced incidents on PLV_APP_ANDROID_2 (2024.2.0) [8], Austria, which experienced an incident on PLV_PAYMENTS_3 (2024.3.0) but also had games affected by INC_017 which was on PLV_APP_IOS_3 (2024.3.0) - wait, let's re-evaluate 'same platform version'. The question asks for the same platform version as INC_037. INC_037 is on PLV_IDENTITY_2 (2024.2.0). Looking at other sources: [2] INC_007 is on PLV_APP_ANDROID_2 (2024.2.0) in market MKT_CZ? No, INC_007 affects games GAME_AT_03 and GAME_AT_04, but the market field is not explicitly listed as MKT_AT in the header, however the games are AT games. Let's look for explicit market fields. [8] INC_034 is in MKT_GR on PLV_APP_ANDROID_2 (2024.2.0). [10] INC_004 is in MKT_CZ on PLV_RETAIL_2 (2024.2.0). So Greece and Czech Republic had incidents on platform versions with 2024.2.0. Austria has INC_009? No, INC_009 is not listed. INC_011 is MKT_AT on PLV_PAYMENTS_3 (2024.3.0). So only Greece and Czech Republic are explicitly marked with 2024.2.0 platform versions in the provided text for other markets? Wait, [2] INC_007 has no market field listed in the bullet points, but affects AT games. However, usually, if market is not specified, we can't assume. But [8] explicitly says MKT_GR and PLV_APP_ANDROID_2 (2024.2.0). [10] explicitly says MKT_CZ and PLV_RETAIL_2 (2024.2.0). Are there any others? [1] is UK. C.verdict: Randomly selected number lines; Losing entries go into a second draw
C.answer: The games affected by incident INC_013 are Albion Millions and Lioness Instant [3]. Albion Millions uses the game mechanic of randomly selected number lines [1]. Lioness Instant is listed as an affected game in incident INC_017, which also lists Union Raffle as affected; Union Raffle uses the mechanic where losing entries go into a second draw [10], [13]. Additionally, Albion Millions and Union Raffle are linked to incident INC_025, confirming Union Raffle's involvement in the broader context of incidents affecting these games [12]. Therefore, the mechanics used by the affected games are randomly selected number lines (Albion Millions) and losing entries going into a second draw (Union Raffle, which is associated with Lioness Instant via incident INC_017).

instance.text: Which games in other markets use the same kind of mechanic as the main mechanic of game GAME_GR_05?
instance.expected_answer: The games in other markets that use the same kind of mechanic as GAME_GR_05's main mechanic MECH_GR_XYSIMO (Symbol reveal) are GAME_AT_05, GAME_CZ_04 and GAME_UK_05.

claims.statement: Game GAME_AT_05 uses mechanic MECH_AT_RUBBELN.
Game GAME_CZ_04 uses mechanic MECH_CZ_STIRANI.
Game GAME_UK_05 uses mechanic MECH_UK_SCRATCH.

A.answer: The main mechanic of game GAME_GR_05 (Peloponnesus Pull) is 'Ξύστε για να αποκαλύψετε σύμβολα' (Scratch to reveal symbols) [1][2]. In other markets, the game Lioness Instant (GAME_UK_05) uses the same mechanic, described as 'Scratch to reveal matching symbols' [10][11][18]. Additionally, the game Edelweiss Instant (GAME_AT_05) uses a similar core mechanic, described as 'Aufrubbeln und Symbole aufdecken' (Scratch to reveal symbols) [12][15].

A.answer: The main mechanic of game GAME_CZ_02 (Moravia Multi) is 'Výběr čísel a porovnání s losováním' (Select numbers and compare with the draw) [1]. In other markets, the game Kingsport Draw (GAME_UK_02) uses the core mechanic 'Match your numbers against the draw' [11], which corresponds to the same kind of number matching mechanic. Additionally, Lioness Instant (GAME_UK_05) is described with the mechanic 'Scratch to reveal matching symbols' in some contexts [13], but its rules specify 'Scratch to reveal matching symbols' as well [18]. However, looking at the specific phrasing 'Match your numbers against the draw' for Kingsport Draw [11] and 'Výběr čísel a porovnání s losováním' for Moravia Multi [2], these are functionally equivalent number-picking games. Lioness Instant is a scratchcard game [13]. Therefore, only Kingsport Draw uses the same kind of mechanic.
